verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents workflow automations that integrate with Linear (alongside Slack and GitHub) for triggering agent tasks, but there is no evidence of Jira, ClickUp, or Monday.com integrations, nor of agents directly managing tickets (creating/updating/closing) rather than just being triggered by webhook events. missing for 10: Jira integration, ClickUp integration, Monday.com integration, evidence of bidirectional ticket management (not just triggering).
